limitations_and_boundaries: The theoretical results rely on asymptotic analysis; finite-sample behavior may differ.
The triangle assumption for Gaussian-NV case may not hold in all simulations.
The method assumes linear DAG models; nonlinear extensions are not addressed.
Sensitivity to penalty coefficients is not fully studied.
Optimization time could be further reduced with early stopping.
Thresholding step is applied heuristically; a systematic method is lacking.
